comparison.objective: Remove individual gnocchi after they float, plate them, and turn off the burner.
comparison.physical_skill: Time slotted-spoon retrieval of multiple pieces from liquid without finger contact.
comparison.success_condition: Pieces must be removed within 45 seconds of floating and rest on the plate; raw removal fails, and full credit also requires burner-off and spoon release.
comparison.reason: Temporal cooking-state response and utensil scooping are materially different from moving-carton body grasping and spill-preserving reject transfer.
